# E0381: a lens's condition is not one the checker can read

The checker reads a comprehension's condition as a pattern over the input: a
presence test, an equality, a type test, or a conjunction of these. A condition
of any other form, such as a comparison, is one it cannot reason about.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int32
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				big?: bool
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			if v0_0.n > 5 {
				big: true
			}
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			n: 0
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0381]: the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:22:4
   |
22 |             if v0_0.n > 5 {
   |             ^^
   |
   = note: the result of lens 0.0->1.0 has fields under v0_0.n > 5, which is not a pattern: a presence test (p != _|_), an equality (p == c) or a type test ((p & T) != _|_) on an input field, or a conjunction (&&) of these
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule unknown-pattern)
   = help: write the mapping in a form the checker can follow, or add a lacuna where it cannot decide
```
